themes_detail.label: Door/Window Damage Surge
themes_detail.summary: Complaints about door and window damage spiked to 8 reports THIS WEEK, a 1,500% increase from the 0.5 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 10.61), suggesting a potential wave of break-ins, vandalism, or storm damage affecting multiple properties across South Beach/Dongan Hills.
evidence: 8 door/window complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average (1,500% spike)
Z-score of 10.61 indicates statistically extreme deviation
No prior pattern documented in 8-week baseline suggests sudden onset
reporting_angles: Interview affected residents about what triggered the sudden spike—break-ins, weather damage, or organized property crime?
Cross-check NYPD incident reports and burglary data for South Beach/Dongan Hills this week

themes_detail.label: Unsanitary Condition Spike
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary condition complaints jumped to 13 reports THIS WEEK, a 136% increase from the 5.5 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.12), indicating a potential acute sanitation crisis affecting public or private spaces in the district.
evidence: 13 unsanitary condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 5.5 weekly average (136% increase)
Z-score of 6.12 indicates statistically significant deviation
Snow/Ice complaints remain highest volume (3,505 over 90 days), suggesting winter conditions may be exacerbating sanitation issues
reporting_angles: Investigate whether winter weather (snow/ice pileup) is creating blocked storm drains or preventing routine sanitation pickup
Identify geographic clusters of complaints to pinpoint specific blocks or facilities with sanitation failures

themes_detail.label: Elevator Maintenance Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints spiked to 5 reports LAST WEEK, a 900% increase from the 0.5 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 9.0), raising concerns about aging building infrastructure and potential safety hazards in residential buildings across the district.
evidence: 5 elevator complaints last week vs. 0.5 weekly average (900% spike)
Z-score of 9.0 indicates severe statistical anomaly
Part of broader maintenance pattern: 11 general maintenance/facility complaints last week (450% above baseline)
reporting_angles: Survey residential buildings to identify which properties are experiencing elevator outages and how long residents have been without service
Interview tenants about accessibility impacts, especially for elderly residents and those with mobility issues

themes_detail.label: Maintenance & Facility Failures
themes_detail.summary: General maintenance and facility complaints jumped to 11 reports LAST WEEK, a 450% increase from the 2.0 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 7.35), suggesting systemic failures across multiple building systems and public infrastructure in South Beach/Dongan Hills.
evidence: 11 maintenance/facility complaints last week vs. 2.0 weekly average (450% increase)
Converges with elevator spike (5 complaints) suggesting building-wide infrastructure stress
reporting_angles: Request 311 detail data to categorize whether complaints are concentrated in specific buildings or spread across the district
Investigate whether winter weather conditions are straining heating, plumbing, and mechanical systems in older residential buildings

themes_detail.label: Bus Stop Infrastructure Demand
themes_detail.summary: Bus stop shelter placement complaints spiked to 3 reports TWO WEEKS AGO, a 2,300% increase from the 0.1 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 8.69), indicating residents are demanding improved transit infrastructure and weather protection.
evidence: 3 bus stop shelter complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly average (2,300% spike)
Z-score of 8.69 indicates statistically extreme deviation
Aligns with recurring community board requests for DOT and DPR infrastructure improvements
reporting_angles: Identify which bus stops residents are complaining about and document current shelter conditions
Interview regular transit users about weather exposure and safety concerns at these stops
